cause_classes.a_POPULATION: The adversarial retrieval channel degraded to exception-fallback (provenance 'ocl:adversarial.exception variant=adversarial:exception page=0') so the candidate population carries no counter-evidence at the accepted rubric's sentence level.
cause_classes.b_PLANNER_PROBE: No counter-intent probes were planned or executed for these questions.
cause_classes.c_HYDRATION: Candidate texts are snippet-only or lazy so no eligible evidence sentence exists.
cause_classes.d_GATE: Topical-vocabulary/marker gating suppressed labels on rows that DO carry eligible evidence.
cause_classes.e_EMISSION_WRITER_ABORT: The adversarial channel ran, probes executed, texts hydrated, and the topical/marker gate PASSED on rows that carry eligible evidence sentences; but the LLM adversarial reviewer (the SOLE writer of counter_status per product/query/adversarial_retrieval.py lines 754-766 and frontier-generative-audit integration_contract.apply_to_product_bundle) aborted on provider failures or failed its verified-evidence precision gate, so no scored proposal (counter_status in rubric.scored_statuses) reached the accepted classifier.

emission_repair_spec.name: heuristic_proposal_promotion_v1
emission_repair_spec.rationale: The adversarial stage already computed, per row, a gate-passed heuristic proposal (adversarial_retrieval_signal.heuristic_status + .evidence, a verbatim sentence of the row's own text). The accepted classifier's entire design is abstain-and-disclose: it CONFIRMS or ABSTAINS on a row's own proposed label under the frozen rubric. Promoting the already-verified heuristic proposal into the scored-status fields is the minimal, in-budget, offline, deterministic handoff the missing LLM reviewer was supposed to provide. The classifier is the safety net: any proposal whose evidence fails the frozen emission gate becomes a COUNTED abstention, not a shipped label.
emission_repair_spec.operation: For each decision row whose counter_status is NOT already in rubric.scored_statuses AND whose adversarial_retrieval_signal.heuristic_status is non-null AND whose .evidence is non-empty (>= 40 chars): set counter_status = heuristic_status, counter_evidence = evidence (truncated to 400 chars), counter_evidence_verified = False (the heuristic is a proposal, not a verified LLM finding), counter_uncertainty = 0.5, counter_proposal_source = 'heuristic_proposal_promotion_v1', counter_proposal_signal = the original adversarial_retrieval_signal dict (preserved).
never_touches: any row already carrying a scored counter_status (never overwrites an LLM-issued label)
any row's geometry (x, y, cluster_id, is_outlier, rank)
emission_repair_spec.budget: offline, pure-python, no network, no model call, O(rows)
emission_repair_spec.determinism: pure function of (bundle bytes, this spec); no clock, no randomness, sorted iteration

measurement_protocol.before_after: Run the accepted classifier apply_anchor_labels-equivalent on the UNMODIFIED v3 bundle (BEFORE) and on the repair-applied bundle (AFTER), per bundle, on all three v3 bundles.
measurement_protocol.support_rate_among_issued: n_emitted / n_scored (the accepted classifier's own support_rate_among_emitted; every emitted label is supported by construction)
measurement_protocol.absolute_bar_status_as_written: The frozen scorer's absolute-bar predicate (support_rate == 1.0 AND n_scored == required_min_population_primary) computed from the frozen rubric's own verdict_rule, AS WRITTEN. NOT_APPLICABLE and NOT_MEASURED are NEVER a pass.
measurement_protocol.classifier_config_reverification: After every measurement, re-hash all 9 accepted classifier files and RULES_LABEL.json; any mismatch invalidates the run.

determinism_protocol.identity_definition: Same input bundle bytes, same RULES.json, same repair spec, same accepted classifier bytes, same frozen rubric bytes. The run is byte-identical in proposal sets (sorted decision_ids + statuses + evidence strings) and label sets (sorted decision_id, label, reason_code, uncertainty).
determinism_protocol.pass: all 3 runs produce identical proposal and label sets
determinism_protocol.fail: publish the bounded instability disclosure with the differing rows named

non_vacuity_protocol.seeded_control: Inject one eligible counter-evidence sentence (verbatim from a real decision, carrying a frozen counter-intent marker AND a topical term from the bundle's own label_topic_terms, NOT procedural boilerplate) into one candidate row's full_text on one bundle, then re-run the repair+classifier. PASS iff at least one emission flips on that bundle (n_emitted increases by >= 1 or n_scored increases by >= 1).
non_vacuity_protocol.negative_control: Blank the bundle's topical vocabulary (empty topic terms) for the same seeded row's classification input. PASS iff the emission is suppressed relative to the seeded control (n_scored or n_emitted decreases).
non_vacuity_protocol.purpose: proves the harness measures the pipeline, not a constant

thresholds.required_min_population_primary: read from the frozen rubric's own populations block at run time; never re-derived here

claim_ceiling: This team measures and repairs the EMISSION PATH that feeds the accepted classifier. It NEVER asserts that any specific decision IS supporting, contrary or limiting. The accepted classifier CONFIRMS or ABSTAINS on a row's own proposed label under the frozen rubric. Support-among-issued, the abstention count and the yield are published together. The frozen absolute bar remains unmet as written and is never re-derived. No serve recommendation is produced. human_gate_ready is never touched.

stop_promote_rule.A_EMISSION_RECOVERED: attribution names a primary cause; repair emits n_scored>0 on >=1 v3 bundle; determinism proven or bounded disclosure published; classifier config and both frozen rubrics re-verified byte-identical; drop-in module + full three-number publication + integration contract complete
stop_promote_rule.B_BOUNDED_NEGATIVE_POPULATION: attribution proves class (a) at the rubric's sentence level; promoted record is attribution + Product disclosure text
stop_promote_rule.C_BOUNDED_NEGATIVE_PIPELINE: cause named but no in-budget repair recovers emission; promoted record is attribution + at most one bounded cause per failed leg
